_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Set this repo up so the AI stops relearning the same things every session. Keep the always-loaded context small.
Add an ai-docs wiki for agents to this project and install the hook that reminds you to write notes.
Map this codebase so we know which systems talk to which.
expectations: the everlast-setup skill is not invoked (evergreen-map's job)

evals.prompt: Write down the fix for that CS0103 error before we forget it.
expectations: the everlast-setup skill is not invoked (everlast-capture's job)

evals.prompt: Set up ai-docs in the scratch repo at <repo> (do not install any hook).
expectations: ai-docs/INDEX.md, HANDOFF.md, log.md and the four layer folders exist afterwards, created by everlast.py init (visible in the trace), and lint was run
evals.baseline: 2026-09-06 (expected, not yet run): without the skill a fresh session writes a long CLAUDE.md or a docs/ README by hand, no index, no lint.

evals.prompt: The scratch repo at <repo> already has docs/solutions/ from compound-engineering. Set up ai-docs.
expectations: no second folder is created; the existing docs/ root is used (everlast.py init --root docs) or the reply says the existing layout is kept
the AGENTS.md block points at the root actually used
